newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end up on rate cut hopes after GDP.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end up on rate cut hopes after GDP.

text.p: South African shares ended strong, bouyed by hopes of an early interest rate cut after a surprise drop in Q1 gross domestic product growth.
Gold shares ended flat, refusing to believe the platinum-inspired bullion price recovery was sustainable.
Dealers said trade was volatile and thin but boosted by bookovers in Iscor and Barlows in the afternoon session.
Some futures-related trade was also seen as players start preparing for the June futures close-out.
The market was seen sideways on Friday as players square positions ahead of the weekend.
The all-share index gained 33.9 points to 7,074.7 points, the industrial index added 36.0 points to 8,317.9 points and the gold index rose 2.8 cents to 1,181.3 points.
